description: This Java class 'JpaRpcDao' implements data access object (DAO) functionalities for RPC entities in the Thingsboard platform, including methods for querying and deleting RPC records based on tenant and device IDs, with support for pagination and status filtering.

classes.name: JpaRpcDao
classes.description: DAO class for RPC entities, providing methods for querying and deleting RPC records, extending JpaAbstractDao and implementing RpcDao and TenantEntityDao interfaces.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the RPC entity, RpcEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying JpaRepository for RpcEntity.

methods.name: findAllByDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated RPCs for a specific device within a tenant.

methods.name: findAllByDeviceIdAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves paginated RPCs for a specific device and status within a tenant.

methods.name: findAllRpcByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all RPCs for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: deleteOutdatedRpcByTenantIdBatch
methods.description: Deletes a batch of outdated RPCs for a tenant based on expiration time.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for findAllRpcByTenantId, retrieves all RPCs for a tenant.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is RPC.
